slug: 2025-06-30 Zimbabwe's Cyber and Data Protection Act - Overview
note: Briefing describes the Act as a data protection law; it states nothing on cybercrime offences or their use.

facts.fact: Zimbabwe's Cyber and Data Protection Act [Chapter 12:07] (Act No. 5 of 2021), gazetted in consolidated form on 11 March 2022, amends sections 162 to 166 of the Criminal Law Act to add cyber offences such as transmitting a false data message intending to cause harm (s.164C) and designates POTRAZ as the data protection authority.
A POTRAZ official said Zimbabwe's Cybersecurity Act incorporates cybercrime definitions alongside cybersecurity provisions in one piece of legislation.

note: A cyberbullying charge is stated but the document does not name the law it is brought under.

Police say their cyber laboratory has resulted in several convictions involving false transmission of messages meant to cause harm nationally; no dates given.
